title: SPAIN HADN'T LOST IN 43 GAMES. THEN ENGLAND TURNED UP IN MADRID.
description:
Spain hadn't lost in 43 games. England didn't read the memo.

Harry Kane scored a penalty. Ezri Konsa and Ben White added two more. That's 3-0, in Madrid.

Then Elliot Anderson was sent off for fouling Lamine Yamal, and England made it interesting, as ever. Oyarzabal and Nico Williams pulled it back, and Yamal set up both. He is 19.

Tuchel called it the best result of his England tenure. For Spain it was the first home defeat in over four years.

Did England earn it, or did Spain let it slip at 3-0? Pick a side below.
